model_annotation: The plot illustrates the average co-occurrence (ACC) percentage as a function of co-occurrence number for various methods. The x-axis represents the co-occurrence number, ranging from 1.0 to 10000, with tick labels spaced by powers of 10, starting at 1.0 and incrementing by 10 each time. The y-axis represents the average co-occurrence percentage in percent, ranging from 30 to 65, with tick labels spaced by 5, starting at 30.0 and incrementing by 5 each time. A black solid line represents the “Base” method, starting at approximately 35% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ending at approximately 60% at co-occurrence number 10000. A light orange dashed line represents the “MEND” method, starting at approximately 40% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ending at approximately 55% at co-occurrence number 10000. A cyan dashed line represents the “FT” method, starting at approximately 45% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ending at approximately 63% at co-occurrence number 10000. A red solid line represents the “IKE” method, starting at approximately 38% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ending at approximately 48% at co-occurrence number 10000. Finally, a forest green solid line represents the “ROME” method, starting at approximately 52% at co-occurrence number 1.0 and ending at approximately 65% at co-occurrence number 10000.
